name: Basic Equilibration Protocol
description: Equilibration protocol adapted from AMBER Tutorial 33 (Constant pH and Redox Potential MD), Sections 2-3. The tutorial's 5-stage explicit-solvent procedure (min -> heat -> NPT equilibration -> NVT equilibration -> production) is split into 6 stages here: the single NPT equilibration is run as a short CPU density segment followed by a GPU relaxation segment, working around the pmemd.cuda failure that occurs when the box volume changes substantially during GPU NPT.
author: AMBER Tutorial 33 - Constant pH and Redox Potential MD (https://ambermd.org/tutorials/advanced/tutorial33)

steps.name: Energy Minimization
steps.description: Energy minimization with protein backbone and metal site restraints (10 kcal/mol·Å²). Removes bad contacts and optimizes initial geometry.

steps.name: System Heating
steps.description: Gradual heating from 0-300K over 2 ns with light restraints (1.0 kcal/mol·Å²). Temperature ramping prevents thermal shock.

steps.name: NPT Density Equilibration
steps.description: NPT equilibration for 1 ns on CPU with very weak restraints (0.1 kcal/mol·Å²). Short phase to converge box density before handing off to GPU; pmemd.cuda can't reallocate the PME grid when the box shrinks here.

steps.name: NPT Relaxation
steps.description: NPT equilibration for 3 ns on GPU with very weak restraints (0.1 kcal/mol·Å²). Continues NPT once density has converged; safe for the fixed pmemd.cuda PME grid. Keeps total NPT at 4 ns.

steps.name: NVT Equilibration
steps.description: Final NVT equilibration for 4 ns with very weak restraints (0.1 kcal/mol·Å²). Prepares system for unrestrained production.

steps.name: NVT Production MD
steps.description: Unrestrained NVT production molecular dynamics for 100 ns. Optional constant pH capability included but commented out.
